fusions.name: Split Tine
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Both Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Looses 2 knives at once along diverging paths, each dealing 26 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Trident Parry
fusions.desc: Raises a parrying guard that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Offshoot
fusions.desc: Every time you land a critical hit, a stack builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 26% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
